title: Twilight theme: contrast-preserving token transforms and component overrides for compact tables & charts
creator: Marisol Ortega
description:
Goal: Introduce a Twilight theme variant that preserves perceived contrast across compact UI surfaces (compact table rows, dense chart axes, and small buttons) while allowing brand accents to remain visible without clipping or color drift.

Scope:
- Define a small set of token transform rules (hue-preserve luminance scaling + perceptual contrast clamps) applied at build-time for the Twilight theme.
- Provide component-level overrides for Button (small / icon-only), Table (compact density, zebra tints), and Chart (axis, grid, point highlights) to avoid washed-out accents in dark backgrounds.
- Add visual regression snapshots for the affected components and a light/dark contrast audit in the design system pipeline.

Out of scope: global theme rebrand, runtime user-custom theme editor, Dedicated deployment controls. This ticket focuses on token transforms and component-level guardrails for the console theme palette.
acceptance_criteria: Design token transform rules documented in the repo README (hue-preserve + luminance clamp) and added to the tokens package for the Twilight theme.
Figma component library updated with overrides for Button (small/icon), Table (compact row, zebra inverted), and Chart (axis stroke/label weights).
Engineering implements the transforms in the tokens build and exposes a theme flag (twilight) that produces the expected CSS variables / token set.
Visual regression tests added and passing; screenshots show no more than 8% perceived contrast delta for branded accents between hosted-brand and twilight variants across components.
Accessibility audit doc with WCAG contrast checks attached and sign-off from accessibility reviewer.
comments: 2025-02-18 Marisol: Initial proposal posted. Attached the research notes comparing luminance-scaling vs alpha-blend approaches for preserving accent visibility on deep surfaces.

2025-02-21 Jasper: Worked with engineering to prototype a luminance-clamp transform. Built a small node script that maps base tokens -> twilight tokens. Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234
2025-02-24 Amina (PM): Requested that compact table row hover states keep a minimum 3:1 contrast with surface to avoid invisible hover affordances on small rows.

2025-02-26 Design review: Decided to prefer hue-preserve luminance scaling over saturation clipping; this keeps brand hue intact. Action: update transform docs and add visual examples for high-saturation brand colors.
2025-02-27 Eng update (Ravi): Token build integrated in branch feature/theme/twilight-tokens. Need one additional token for chart-muted-line to avoid aliasing on retina displays. Filed ENG-52300.

2025-03-01 Jasper: Updated Figma components and uploaded new compact table variants to the library (link below). Started a cross-browser check for chart stroke widths. Waiting on ENG-52300 fix before merging the PR.
2025-03-01 Marisol: Tagging accessibility reviewer Ethan for contrast sign-off. Note: labels on tiny icon-only buttons must reach 3:1 for icon shapes per our small-touch guidelines.
notes: Engineering prefers to run transforms at token-build time for determinism; we agreed to ship with a feature flag. If we need runtime per-customer accents later, that will be a follow-up (ENG-53011).
